ui.aboutIntro: What it is, what the review looks at, and where plugins live after installing.
ui.faqWhatA: A hand-reviewed directory of DeepSeek Harness plugins. Someone read each plugin's source and wrote down whether it uses the network, reads or writes files, runs commands, and where to find it after installing.
ui.faqVsDiscover: How is it different from DSH's Discover page?
ui.faqVsDiscoverA: Discover lists what it can find; Plugin Home lists reviewed versions only and puts the permissions and the review up front. Its directory is also a standard index, readable from Discover without this plugin.
ui.faqHowInstall: How do I install a plugin?
ui.faqHowInstallA: Press Install on a plugin's page: DSH's own install dialog opens and nothing installs until you confirm. You can also enter "name@version" in Plugins → Add plugin.
ui.faqWhereIsIt: I installed it; where is it?
ui.faqWhereIsItA: Every plugin page has "After installing": where to find it and what to try first.
ui.faqWhyOld: Upstream has a newer version; why is this one older?
ui.faqWhyOldA: Plugin Home lists reviewed versions only. New upstream versions are found and compared with the reviewed one automatically, and listed once reviewed.
ui.faqReviewWhat: What does the review look at?
ui.faqReviewWhatA: The package source, read by a person with an automatic scan alongside: network use, file access, commands, agent tools, install scripts, prebuilt binaries, self-updating around DSH's plugin manager, and reading other software's logins, which is never listed.
ui.faqNetworkA: Not necessarily: many plugins need it to work. The marks tell you what a plugin does, and the review says where it connects.
ui.askBody: Open an issue on GitHub with the npm package or repository.
